name: Boosteroid Game
description: Tells ConsoleDeck which game Boosteroid is streaming, so each game can have its own profile (Boosteroid · Last Epoch). Add one from the + menu while the game is in front; it falls back to the Boosteroid profile, then Default. While Boosteroid is in front it taps Shift when Boosteroid warns of inactivity, so the stream isn't ended.
